notes:
Prospect background: QuickStitch builds a CX automation layer that sits between ticketing systems and agents. Focused on SMB customers (50-500 seats). Primary goal is to reduce MTTR via automated first-pass summarization and automated ticket updates (tool-calling to update Zendesk/Sheets).

What they told us: "We need short, consistent ticket summaries that include structured fields (issue_type, suggested_owner, SLA_risk) plus an audit-friendly trail when the bot performs actions." CTO: wants hosted API for speed to market but flagged audit/logging and token cost.

Technical requirements / preferences: prefer small-ish LLMs for cost; will route high-risk tickets to larger model. Need structured JSON output for downstream ingestion, deterministic validation, and webhook-based tool-calls that can be retried. Interested in Redwood's streaming for agent UX and function-calling style interface for ticket updates.

Trial plan: 1-week POC using hosted_api, 1k daily ticket volume simulation, integrate with dev Zendesk sandbox and a Google Sheet for ticket writebacks. Want sample prompt cookbook and example tool-calling flows.

Sales notes: good PLG motion — user already self-signed and exercised free credits. Upside: low-friction path to conversion if cost per token and audit answers are satisfactory. Risks: legal (SOC2) and bookkeeping for tool-call side effects.

Direct quote from CTO on 2026-03-05 call: "If we can keep the cost predictable and get reliable structured output, we can flip this on for 200 customers in a month."
short_description: SMB support automation vendor evaluating Redwood Hosted API for ticket summarization + tool-calling; early discovery, public cloud, cost-sensitive.
